text:
Unit planning takes a lot of mental energy—especially in May. You got the big framework and assessments locked in, which is the hardest part. 

Definitely a good point to close the laptop and rest. If you want rubrics, student handouts, or the actual DNA sequences/pedigrees generated later so you don't have to build them from scratch when you're back at it, just say the word whenever you're ready. Have a relaxing rest of your day!
